project_identity.name: Holy Book / The Book of Everything — Digital Codex
project_identity.creator: Mahakali Studios (Owned editorially by Mahakali Tribe LLP)
project_identity.archetype: Swiss Architectural Editorial & Digital Codex Manuscript
project_identity.core_premise: A public, evidence-aware digital codex presenting the complete uploaded manuscript with editorial transparency. It presents provocative propositions without pretending 'makes holy books obsolete' is established fact, pairing rigorous citation systems with scholar/simple reading modes.
anti_patterns: No generic SaaS gradient blue UI
No spiritual/denominational iconography or religious symbols
No centered text layout disease for body paragraphs
No transparent headers over content without optical blur
No unlabelled or un-grounded proposition cards

color_system.theme_strategy: Ivory / Graphite Archival Codex with Dark Parchment option

typography.font_loading_instructions: Import Google Fonts: Outfit (500,700,800), Cormorant Garamond (400,400i,600,700), JetBrains Mono (400,500) into src/index.css

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none uppercase

spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Swiss Archival Grid with Monastic Margins
spacing_and_layout.bento_ratios: col-span-12 for Hero Codices, col-span-8 / col-span-4 for Reader split pane, col-span-4 / col-span-4 / col-span-4 for Statistics & Contradictions

navigation_bar.style: Sticky Archival Header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FBF9F5]/90 dark:bg-[#121211]/90 border-b border-[#E2DDD3] dark:border-[#31302C]

modes: Scholar Mode (Propositions, confidence scores, parallel citations, version history, margin notes)
features: Escher Geometric Line Art Section Headers

map_of_everything.visual_graph: Interactive Canvas/SVG node network with drag/zoom support
map_of_everything.accessible_alternative: Searchable, sortable hierarchy table with level indents, filter by connection count

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display headers
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations with useReducedMotion checks or standard CSS media queries
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Full focus-visible ring outline styling (ring-2 ring-[#A37B3E])
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements must include kebab-case role attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-book-reader-link', data-testid='scholar-mode-toggle', data-testid='proposition-card-prop-101')

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts ('Outfit', 'Cormorant Garamond', 'JetBrains Mono') in src/index.css
Implement light and dark mode toggle using standard Tailwind dark class
Ensure header navigation has data-testid for all links and actions
Create mock data for all 144 Chapters, statistics, citations, counterarguments, and revision logs if backend endpoints are not present
Add non-infallibility disclaimer clearly on the homepage hero section
Provide Scholar Mode and Simple Mode toggles in the Book Reader view
Provide both visual Graph view and Accessible Table view for 'Map of Everything'
Add Sonner toast notifications for user interactions (bookmarking, submitting challenges, note saving)
